assignment_statement: Read n (1 <= n <= 20000), followed by n signed 32-bit integers. Print the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence followed by a newline. A subsequence preserves input order but need not be contiguous; equal values cannot extend it. Use O(n log n) time and O(n) auxiliary memory.

spec_summary: Read n (1 <= n <= 20000), followed by n signed 32-bit integers. Print the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence followed by a newline. A subsequence preserves input order but need not be contiguous; equal values cannot extend it. Use O(n log n) time and O(n) auxiliary memory.

control_flow_and_data_types: Uses signed 32-bit integers for input values.
Uses signed 64-bit integers for best length (though n limits it to 20000).
Iterates i from 0 to n-1 to initialize dp[i] = 1.
Iterates j from 0 to i-1 to update dp[i] based on strictly increasing condition.
Updates best variable with maximum dp[i] found.
Uses free() to release heap memory on error paths.
Returns 1 on any validation failure or memory allocation failure.
submission_analysis.implementation_summary: The program reads n and n signed 32-bit integers, then computes the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence using dynamic programming. It initializes dp[i] to 1 and iterates to find the maximum dp[j] + 1 where values[j] < values[i].
input_parsing_and_validation: Validates n is within [1, 20000] via scanf return check.
Allocates memory for values and dp arrays.
Checks for allocation failure and frees allocated memory on error.
Reads n integers into values array, validating each read returns 1.
Handles EOF or read failures by freeing allocated memory and returning 1.
likely_weak_points: Does not check if n is 0 before allocating arrays (though range check covers it).
Does not verify values[i] fits in signed 32-bit range during read.
Does not handle negative values correctly if they break the strictly increasing logic unexpectedly.
Does not check for duplicate values in the input sequence.
Does not verify that dp[i] is initialized to 1 before the inner loop.
Does not validate that n is at least 1 before allocating arrays.
recommended_test_dimensions: n = 20000 with all values strictly decreasing.
n = 20000 with all values forming a strictly increasing sequence.
n = 20000 with values forming a strictly decreasing sequence.
n = 20000 with values forming a zigzag pattern.
